title: Member-Decision Value — How Riverbend Figures the Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) Close-Out
content:
**Reimbursement Analysis memo.**

1. *What it covers.* The member-decision value of an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) covers the charges of the claim's hospital account (the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)) except the pre-operative tests (revenue codes 0300, 0730 and 0324), which stay payable, and the take-home convenience items on Riverbend's convenience list (E0218, A9273 and A4467 under revenue code 0274), which it never values; it covers the small items on Riverbend's outpatient-surgery small-item list that pass the small-item test (a listed code whose charges are above 0.00 and at or below the payer class's small-denial write-off amount) only while no below-threshold write-off entry stands on the claim, and it always covers a listed code that does not pass.
2. *How it is read.* Within what it covers, the operating-room lines (revenue code 0360), the implant lines (revenue code 0278), the anesthesia (revenue code 0370) and recovery (revenue code 0710) lines, the ancillary lines (revenue codes 0250 and 0272) and the crutches (code E0114 under revenue code 0274) are each read by their charges, and everything else as the remaining charges.
3. *The value.* The member-decision value is the charges it covers multiplied by the payer class's expected allowed percentage of charges.
4. *Assembly.* Each group of lines is valued first, never above the billed charges of the lines it values (Riverbend's agreements pay the lesser of the scheduled amount and the billed charges); a multiplier of the total applies after them, then the recovery limit, and the total is then rounded once.
5. *Recovery limit.* The member-decision value never exceeds what the payer has recovered on the claim, the total of its recovery entries, less the below-threshold write-offs already on the claim, and is never below 0.00; with no recovery entry on the claim it is 0.00.
6. *When it is fixed.* The member-decision value is fixed only after the payer's recovery of its payment stands as a recovery entry on the claim. The member-decision value is fixed only after the small items that pass the small-item test carry their below-threshold write-off entry on the claim.
7. *Rounding.* The member-decision value is rounded to the nearest cent once, on the final total, and when it is 0.00 no entry is written.

**Worked example (hypothetical, payer class modeled at 50%).** Account charges 20,000.00, of which pre-operative tests 1,000.00 and convenience items 300.00; one passing small item of 40.00 with a below-threshold write-off entry of 20.00 already on the claim. Covered charges: 20,000.00 less 1,000.00, 300.00 and 40.00 is 18,660.00; at 50% → 9,330.00. Recovery entries total 9,000.00; less the 20.00 write-off the limit is 8,980.00, so the value is 8,980.00.
